patch.value: Implement companion specification pm-cli-website-c98t locally; no publication.
Seven CLI and SDK operations; complete exact feasible coverage witnesses; native guarded storage; public proof; all release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Companion reference: pm-cli-website-c98t. Source specification and comments read only. Implement the complete production v1 slice; strength above two and autonomous execution remain follow-ups.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation and evidence are complete for local first-release review. Companion pm-cli-website-c98t remains read-only. Package-owned links identify source, docs and tests; public harness receipt proves three selected upstream tests and one reproduced historical regression. Required final validation commands are npm run release:check and bun run release:check with isolated Git identity configuration. No repository creation, pushing, publication or hosted operation is authorized. Remaining capabilities are explicitly tracked as open Features; items remain open for orchestrator verification.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Orchestrator opened public PR 1 at the completed implementation head. Resuming review ownership: inspect CodeRabbit including outside-diff and nitpick content, address findings, validate changes, push all package-owned tracker records, and verify final CI. Existing implementation and public proofs remain complete.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review round one is queued for PR 1. Automatic CodeRabbit and Sourcery skips are missing review evidence; both notices received negative reactions. The requested voting script hit a GraphQL API rate limit, so equivalent notice reactions were submitted through REST. No findings or CI failures are currently available; CI jobs are queued. Preserve the completed source validation and wait for the manual review and final-head CI before declaring review complete.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final-head CI passed Node 22, Node 26 and CodeQL on d45600d, while the shared CodeRabbit queue had not reached PR 1. Independent receipt-integrity review then reproduced and fixed a one-to-one outcome-binding gap. Focused native test, linked test, typecheck, lint, duplication, docstrings and five behavioral revert proofs pass. Push the narrow fix, requeue review and rerun both full release checks on the new candidate. Existing public model and byte-reduction results are unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review round two: CodeRabbit posted 13 unresolved review threads on PR 1 (no outside-diff findings in the review body or PR comments; Sourcery skipped). Resuming the epic's review ownership: verify every thread against current code, fix valid findings with regression tests and behavioral revert proofs, self-review the full PR diff for the same defect classes, run targeted gates plus changelog/identity checks, then push for CI certification of the full release gate.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round two step one is fixed and validated locally: kernel reuse, path-guard scoping and traversal budget landed with three new regression tests; the linked suite passes 69 of 69 tests and the revert acceptance proves 8 red and 8 restored-green behavioral proofs. Remaining round-two work: pack-gate document presence, tightened refusal-code assertions, the writer lock_conflict retry, corpus-privacy import boundaries, public-harness per-test verification with receipt regeneration, live resume-question checks, exact CI runtimes and the linked-test build prefixes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Continuation inspected the existing branch, uncommitted patch, all 13 unresolved threads with complete comments, latest review and tracker records. Retained the three completed fixes and four pending edits in an isolated worktree; no outside-diff findings, no duplicate PR or tracker items. Remaining fixes and final exact-head validation are in progress.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: All thirteen review findings are valid. Preserved the prior three fixes and completed explicit package-document presence checks, exact native refusal codes, writer contention retries, acquisition import/member restrictions, named concrete harness test results, exact CI runtime provisioning, frozen harness bindings, live current-packet resume questions, and build-prefixed linked commands. Whole-diff follow-up found and fixed cache hits bypassing strict input validation and synthetic public URL literals violating the tracked privacy gate. Public harness regeneration passes three selected tests and reproduces one historical regression, followed by restored success. Remaining work: behavioral revert certification, linked execution and complete npm/Bun release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert certification passed: 18 isolated mutants fail and all 18 restored implementations pass. Covered prior tuple/replay/CAS/budget/receipt guards; public path, shared-DAG work bound and deterministic reuse; required packed docs; acquisition named imports and member calls; concrete selected harness results; frozen receipt bindings; lock retries; CI runtime refusal; live packet answers; and validation before both cache lookups. Four clean-dist linked commands fail without their build prefix and pass with it. Three injected wrong native/domain error codes fail the strengthened assertions and pass after restoration. Every temporary change was confined to disposable copies; package source/history was not altered by proofs. A normal-home health check discovered an unrelated globally installed extension version skew; the isolated-home authoritative tracker check passes without dependency or threshold changes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final local release certification: npm run release:check and bun run release:check each passed all 14 stages via pinned pm test --run --progress in isolated homes/Git configuration. Each measured 75 tests, zero failures/skips, 100 percent coverage of 560 statements/306 branches/167 functions/446 lines across eight runtime modules; 98 documented declarations; zero duplication at the unchanged zero threshold; zero production vulnerabilities; 41 allowlisted packed files. Packed acceptance passed 31 CLI commands per package manager, SDK checks, and both SDK/CLI checks on exact Node 22.19.0 and 26.13.0 under each manager. Each full gate passed 18 red/18 restored-green behavioral proofs, four clean-dist build-prefix proofs and three wrong-error-code probes. Final paired-receipt/privacy assertions separately passed seven focused tests; three helper tests also pass on the minimum Node runtime. Earlier gate attempts exposed duplicated proof scaffolding, now factored out; the final gates pass without changed thresholds. Existing local extension skew is avoided by the required isolated home. Final commit/CI verification follows; items remain in_progress for orchestrator verification.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Re-review continuation: reuse existing PR 1 and epic, preserve prior commits; branch matches remote and contains origin/main. Four valid classes: prerequisite-complete archive instructions, consistent transient native contention metadata, stored-state validation separated from submission guards across every kernel/API read path, and finite contention retries. Audit SDK/CLI JSON/TOON, packed npm/Bun consumers and real non-git trackers; add adversarial regressions and isolated revert proofs before full gates. Previous head 4f3f70e now has successful Node 22 and Node 26 CI jobs, resolving the earlier evidence-only runtime blocker. No outside-diff findings in latest review.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Class audit completed across all runtime modules and documentation: only new submissions run guardSubmitted; every stored normalization, domain enumeration and cover generation now propagates stored mode through reads, proposals, select/record preflight, coverage, explanation, packets and recovery. Cache validation remains strict for new submissions. Transient metadata is centralized in CaseRefusal and preserved through native conversion and JSON/TOON. Writer retries now have validated finite caps, preserve the last failure and invoke conflict callbacks only before another attempt; worker processes have a timeout and pagination tests assert bounded progress. No additional archive-install sites or unbounded contention loops remain. Focused linked test command passed 51/51; typecheck, lint, zero-duplication and docstrings pass. Added packed npm/Bun legacy-state and strict-resubmission journeys without Git. Initial revert proof harness required an assertion wrapper for expected privacy refusals; rerunning the unchanged failure checks after that correction.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Revert proof: npm run test:revert passed 31 isolated red mutants and 31 restored-green reruns, plus 4 clean-dist build-prefix proofs and 3 wrong-error-code probes. New mutants independently remove the README archive prerequisite, lock_conflict retry metadata, finite writer attempt guard, and each of ten stored-mode handoffs in normalizeModel, enumerateFeasibleTuples, generateCover, readState, evaluateCaseCoverage and API proposal/select/explain. All mutations run in disposable copies; fixed source and history remain intact. These adversarial tests also prove new submissions still refuse after legacy data warms both caches. Full npm and Bun release checks are now running sequentially through pinned pm linked tests, with isolated home/Git configuration and unchanged thresholds.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final re-review gates: npm run release:check and bun run release:check each passed all 14 stages via pinned pm test --run --progress, sequentially with isolated home/Git configuration and at most 2 test workers. Each passed 79/79 tests with zero failures/skips; 100 percent coverage of 560 statements, 309 branches, 167 functions and 446 lines across 8 runtime modules; 98 documented declarations; zero duplication across 51 sources and zero production vulnerabilities. Each passed packed acceptance: 41 allowlisted files, 42 CLI commands per npm/Bun consumer journey, SDK checks, and exact Node 22.19.0/26.13.0 SDK/CLI checks without Git on PATH. Each also passed 31 red/31 restored-green behavioral mutants, 4 clean-build proofs and 3 wrong-error-code probes. Retained ignored archive matches the validated consumer artifact: SHA-256 26ac5778de2ba5b18024efb64047864b0cfccaf10a34a80c2cf4d3fab3d66cb7. Prior focused linked suite passed 51/51. No pm CLI/SDK defect or new out-of-scope work was found; final-head external CI/review follows the push at https://github.com/unbraind/pm-case/pull/1/checks.
